messages.subject: Project Lyra — disclosure schedule and Aldridge Seed release
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Draft disclosure schedule from our side is in the data room (folder 8). We've disclosed the Aldridge Seed charge with the conditional deed of release at 5.5; an executed unconditional release will be delivered at completion. Please confirm Hartwell is content to take the charge as a disclosed-but-managed item rather than a condition precedent.

Deepa
